notes.title: 🚀 Fuel & Fury is Now Live on Steam! Join the Apocalypse! 🎃🔥
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Fuel & Fury has officially launched as part of Steam's Scream Fest! Step into a gritty, post-apocalyptic world packed with zombie hordes, deadly bosses, and endless action.

[b]Game Features[/b]:

[list]
[*] [b]Roguelike Gameplay[/b]: Every run is unique, bringing fresh challenges.
[*] [b]Epic Boss Battles[/b]: Test your skills against powerful foes like Big Benny.
[*] [b]Atmospheric Apocalypse Setting[/b]: Drive, dash, and survive the wasteland.
[/list]

Watch the launch trailer [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206420/FUEL__FURY/]here[/url] and experience Fuel & Fury!

notes.title: Fuel & Fury Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[h1] Fuel & Fury: Launching October 28th for Scream Fest! 🎃🔥 [/h1]

[b]We’re thrilled to announce that Fuel & Fury will officially launch on October 28th as part of Steam’s Scream Fest![/b]

Prepare to drive, dash, and survive in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and terrifying bosses. With procedurally generated levels, every playthrough offers fresh challenges. Face off against powerful enemies like Big Benny and navigate the dangers of a radioactive wasteland!

[h2] Game Features: [/h2] [b]Roguelike Gameplay:[/b] No two playthroughs are ever the same.
[b]Epic Boss Battles:[/b] Test your skills against unique bosses with challenging abilities.
[b]Atmospheric Apocalypse Setting:[/b] Immerse yourself in a gritty world where survival is everything.

[b]Add Fuel & Fury to your wishlist[/b] to be ready for the launch, and stay tuned for more updates. We can't wait to bring you this action-packed adventure!
